title: cydonia japonica
intro: Cydonia japonica, commonly known as the Japanese quince, is a flowering plant species in the rose family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and fever, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cydonia japonica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and antifungal activities. The plant has also been used to promote relaxation and reduce stress due to its calming effects, making it a popular ingredient in herbal teas and supplements.
